title: Man arrested over alleged plot to attack Texas state capitol
summary:
Suspect Benny Caldera Jr held on bond as officials say they received ‘credible’ information about Austin threat

A 40-year-old man was arrested early Wednesday on suspicion of plotting to…

blocks.text: A 40-year-old man was arrested early Wednesday on suspicion of plotting to attack the Texas state capitol, authorities said.
The Texas department of public safety said in a statement that it received “credible information about an individual planning a violent attack” for Thursday in Austin.
The tip came in Tuesday evening, and Swat officers made the arrest at about 3am on Wednesday at a residence in Converse, Texas, near San Antonio.

Benny Caldera Jr was jailed on a $75,000 bond. He could face charges including felony terroristic threat against a public servant, officials said in a statement. Messages were left seeking comment from an attorney listed for Caldera.

Officials did not provide details about the alleged plot, citing the ongoing investigation. Public safety officials notified state lawmakers about the threat and arrest early on Wednesday. The Capitol remained open during regular operating hours.
Texas senate secretary Patsy Spaw said in a notice that there will be increased security at the Capitol during the investigation.
Governor Greg Abbott said the state DPS was assisted by the FBI in making the arrest.
“Texas will NOT tolerate threats of violence against our Capitol,” the governor said in a statement on social media.
